newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil trudges up on futures, prems steady.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil trudges up on futures, prems steady.

text.p: NWE gas oil was a touch firmer on Monday as IPE futures gained ground, but differentials were little changed in a fundementally slow market.
August IPE gas oil was 75 cents stronger at $172.25 after Friday's $2.25 gain on the back of refinery problems in northwest Europe.
But a strong dollar and absence of an arbitrage opportunity has combined with seasonal quietness to dampen down activity, dealers said.
Heating oil barges wree assessed around +$1.00 fob ARA, about the same level for delivered German spec cargoes.
Parcels of EN590 were unchanged with delivered cargoes assessed around +$4.50-5.50 against August IPE. Traders said talk was fairly sparse.
"People say they are looking for material, but really they just want to get a handle on the price," said one trader.
